project.title: 16S rRNA sequences from atmospheric bioaerosols from Mexico city
project.description: Determine the structure of the airborne bacterial community composition from Mexico city in three areas with different rates of urbanization during the dry and rainy season in order to detect possible biological agents that impact the health of the population.
